interpretation_limits: Acoustic proxies are not phoneme truth. Correlation and best spectral matches are not proof of timing displacement, identity, or causality. Clip end is not utterance end.
feature_notes: RMS=sqrt(sum((frame*Hann)^2)/sum(Hann^2)); epsilon never added to power. dB floor applied only after sqrt. 40ms periodicity is an acoustic proxy, not phoneme truth. Spectral cosines use 16 fixed linear-frequency power bands.

fullband.positive_lag_definition: output y later: compare clean x[t] with output y[t+lag]
fullband.limit: Context-wide similarity diagnostic; not proof of timing displacement.
